name: void-pulse
description: Neon twin-stick roguelite built from scratch in vanilla JS - custom engine, synthesized audio, zero dependencies

paragraphs: A neon twin-stick roguelite built from scratch in vanilla JavaScript. Custom engine · online co-op over WebRTC · spring-mass warp grid · synthesized audio · zero dependencies · no build step.
▶ Play in the browser · works on desktop, gamepad and mobile

Most browser games lean on Phaser, Pixi or Three.js. VOID PULSE uses none of them. Everything you see and hear (the physics, collision, rendering pipeline, particle system, music sequencer, input layer) is hand-written on top of raw browser APIs: Canvas 2D, Web Audio and the Gamepad API. The whole thing ships as plain ES modules: clone it, serve it, play it.
features: Online co-op for two. Create a room, send a friend the link, and fly together. Browsers connect directly over WebRTC. With two pilots, enemies get 60% more health (75% for bosses) and waves are 50% bigger. A downed…

7 enemy archetypes with distinct AI. Seekers home in. Dodgers read incoming bullets and sidestep them. Splitters burst into fragments. Snipers hold range and fire telegraphed shots. Singularities bend bullets, drag…
Five bosses in rotation, every 5th wave, each with an enraged second phase:
Hydra Core: radial bursts, spirals, aimed volleys and summons;
Laser Warden: telegraphed laser beams that sweep the arena (two, then four), bullet flowers and dodger escorts;
